title: GLaS-JEPA: Gaussian-Regularized Speech SSL without Engineered Prediction Targets
abstract: arXiv:2609.37798v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Speech self-supervised learning aims to learn general-purpose representations for downstream speech tasks. However, current approaches rely on complex, carefully designed prediction targets. We challenge this necessity with GLaS-JEPA, a framework that directly predicts the current encoder's continuous representations at masked positions, without contrastive learning, discrete targets, or separate EMA target encoders. We prevent representation collapse using SIGReg representation-space regularization, eliminating the need for engineered target-generation mechanisms. Pretrained on 960 hours of LibriSpeech, our 57M-parameter model achieves a 6.89% WER on frozen-encoder SUPERB ASR and a 25.87% CER on slot filling, outperforming the best non-distilled sub-90M baselines by 43.1% and 22.0%, respectively. These results demonstrate that highly competitive speech representations can emerge from a radically simplified training recipe.

translated_title: GLaS-JEPA：无需人工设计预测目标的高斯正则化语音自监督学习
translated_abstract: 语音自监督学习旨在为下游语音任务学习通用表示。然而，当前的方法依赖于复杂的、精心设计的预测目标。我们用 GLaS-JEPA 挑战了这一必要性，该框架直接在掩码位置预测当前编码器的连续表示，无需对比学习、离散目标或单独的 EMA 目标编码器。我们使用 SIGReg 表示空间正则化来防止表示坍塌，从而消除了对人工设计的目标生成机制的需求。在 960 小时的 LibriSpeech 上预训练后，我们 5700 万参数的模型在冻结编码器的 SUPERB ASR 任务上取得了 6.89% 的词错误率（WER），在槽填充任务上取得了 25.87% 的字错误率（CER），分别比最佳的非蒸馏 9000 万参数以下基线高出 43.1% 和 22.0%。这些结果表明，极具竞争力的语音表示可以从极其简化的训练方案中涌现。
tldr: GLaS-JEPA 通过直接预测掩码位置的连续表示并结合 SIGReg 正则化防止表示坍塌，摆脱了对人工设计预测目标的依赖，以仅 5700 万参数在 SUPERB 基准上显著超越现有最佳基线。
en_tdlr: GLaS-JEPA eliminates engineered prediction targets by directly predicting continuous representations at masked positions with SIGReg regularization, achieving superior SUPERB results with only 57M parameters.
